definitions.short: a spread of the hand , i.e. a palm-breadth (not 'span' of the fingers); architecturally, a corbel (as a supporting palm)
definitions.full: H2947. tephach טֶ֫פַח noun [masculine] 1 a span, hand-breadth ; 2 coping (?); — 1 a span, hand-breadth , טֶ֫פַח 1Kin 7:26 2Chr 4:5 of thickness of the molten sea; plural טְפָחוֺת Psa 39:6 (a few) hand-breadths are my days. 2 architectural term, perh . coping , עַדהַֿטְּפָחוֺת וּמִמַּסַּד 1Kin 7:9 .
